reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin providing structured, read-only Windows device and host information through 12 win_* tools, including hardware, networking, power, processes, and peripherals.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供结构化的只读 Windows 设备信息查询工具，涵盖硬件、网络、电源、进程及外设。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with structured, read-only Windows device information tools covering hardware, networking, power, processes, and peripherals.

capabilities: Reads Windows system, hardware, network, battery, process, USB, audio, and printer information
Executes read-only PowerShell, WMI/CIM, netsh, and powercfg queries
Reports potentially sensitive host details including hostname, user, BIOS serial, Wi-Fi SSID, and running processes
